node.statement: Ideal-support estimates before compression. Put q_n=I_n tensor q, P_n=v_n(q_n), and Z=v_n(x). Since q_n x=x q_n=x in M_n tensor J, the multiplicative clause of the extended alpha-inclusion gives ||P_n Z-Z||<=alpha||x|| and ||ZP_n-Z||<=alpha||x||. Its norm bounds also give ||P_n||<=1+alpha and ||Z||<=(1+alpha)||x||.
